dateLabel: c. 1,500 years ago (left India); Balkans c. 900 years ago
title: Romani ancestors leave northwestern India
place: Northwestern South Asia to the Balkans
summary: Genetic studies (2012) suggest the Roma descend from a single group that left northwestern India about 1,500 years ago and reached the Balkans about 900 years ago. Historians often place the departure around 1000 CE.
why: Genes and language agree that the Roma came from India.

notes.problem: 'Europe's largest minority' is not in the cited source.
